title: Etiquette & language
body:
Portuguese is the official language; English is common in Lisbon and Porto's tourist-facing spots but thins out fast in neighborhood cafés and markets — a few phrases go a long way (see the Trip Kit's phrase cards).

Lunch is the main meal, roughly noon–14:30; dinner runs later than a typical US schedule, 19:30–22:30. The bread/olives 'couvert' brought to your table unasked is a real charge if eaten, but you can send it back at no cost — see the Plan tab for the exact rule.
